title: pnpm-lock.yaml importer entry for apps/api devDependency esbuild was hand-edited (no pnpm available) and the Docker images were never built
evidence: docker is not installed on this machine and pnpm cannot run, so `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` against the edited lockfile and both image builds are unverified. The edit adds esbuild specifier 0.28.2 / version 0.28.2, an existing snapshot (tsx@4.23.13 already resolves esbuild 0.28.2).
fix_direction: On a machine with pnpm and docker: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, docker build -f apps/api/Dockerfile ., docker build -f apps/web/Dockerfile ., then docker run and check the container health status.

title: Brain routes read <root>/data/** and <root>/raw/** at runtime; these are data, not shipped in the image
area: apps/api/src/routes/brain.ts (data/toc-migrated, data/webinar-release/operations.json, source.path files); composition/production.ts withSessionArtifacts root
evidence: root resolves to /app in the image; routes guard with existsSync so they degrade to empty rather than crash, but /brain returns nothing unless a volume is mounted at /app/data (and /app/raw).
fix_direction: Owner/deploycompose decision: mount path and whether /brain is in scope for the first deployment.

title: Bundle build relies on a per-file import.meta.url rewrite; the schema/ and config/ reads are verified by path arithmetic, not executed past the Mongo connect
evidence: Smoke start stops at MongoServerSelectionError (unreachable port by design), before buildProductionDeps reads config/ai-routing.yaml. The rewrite applies to .ts files under the repo root; a bundle location other than apps/api/dist breaks all four lookups.
fix_direction: Add a test that the built bundle can load schema/index.json and config/ai-routing.yaml once a Mongo-free seam exists.
